Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high-fidelity fullscreen Windows desktop game UI mockup, wide 16:9 composition, preferably 1920x1080. This is one actual game screen, not a presentation sheet, not a device mockup, no browser or editor chrome. Game: Chinese 3D grid-based Sokoban puzzle "空间站重启", English secondary name "STATION RESTART". The maintenance robot pushes identical energy cubes into power sockets to open powered gates and restart a space station. Existing character appearance to faithfully reproduce: a small squat robot with two chunky black rubber caterpillar tracks, exactly one rectangular white box torso, a smaller rounded rectangular white box head, a black face screen with two simple vertical pale-cyan rectangular eyes, a small flat orange panel on top of its head, subtle orange side accents, and a broad white pushing plate framed in dark charcoal at the front of the torso. No arms, no legs, no hands, no antenna, no mascot redesign. Scene is restrained stylized low-poly 3D, white and cool-gray modular square floor tiles, gray walls, white cubic energy crates with a large orange plus sign, cyan powered sockets and simple orange-accented gates. Maintain simple blockout-like geometry, soft clean ambient occlusion, calm light. Unified UI visual language: off-white porcelain panels, deep graphite text, warm amber orange primary actions, pale cyan status accents derived from the robot, thin hairline dividers, restrained 12px rounded corners, generous whitespace, clear typography, precise aligned spacing. Chinese type should look like Noto Sans SC, strong legible hierarchy and real readable characters. Tiny English technical labels can accompany Chinese. No neon cyberpunk, no busy holograms, no combat HUD, health bars, currency, stars, ratings, timers, upgrades, invented game modes or watermarks. Render all specified labels exactly once in their specified location; no gibberish filler text.
Screen: MAIN MENU. Warm, airy, minimal and inviting. The screen is divided naturally into a quiet typography area on the left and an elegant 3D space-station puzzle diorama on the right, with continuous light off-white backdrop. On the right, show the recognizable robot in a friendly front three-quarter view, next to one white energy crate bearing an orange plus sign and a nearby cyan floor socket, on a small square-grid platform with a few simple station wall segments. Character large enough to be recognizable but not cartoonishly distorted. The background supports the UI; keep ample negative space and subtle long shadows.
Left: a very small orange plus-sign emblem followed by "STATION RESTART", then a large bold two-line Chinese game title "空间站" and "重启". Below, the exact short premise "推动能源，点亮空间站。" in secondary gray type.
Underneath, a vertical menu with generous spacing: dominant wide amber button with a simple play icon and text "开始游戏"; quieter white outlined button "关卡选择"; smaller understated text actions "设置" and "退出游戏". No continue game button or locked progress.
Bottom-left small restrained line "3D 推箱子 · 键盘与鼠标". No development/build or implementation metadata.
Prioritize the quality of layout, button states, Chinese typography and robot silhouette. The result should be a convincing finished main menu UI concept.
